segments.title: Closing and Raid to Dank Sauce
segments.notes: DJ Newsic ends stream with shoutouts, candle tip grab with consent, reveals Case's kink is talking to chat, raids Dank Sauce.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts Jon Matteson for a Valentine's Day broadcast that spirals through a Drake penis investigation led by Chet, a Brian Johnson interview revealing essence-swapping rejuvenation and werewolf ascension plans, a surreal Dr. Chet therapy session, Peter Gibbon's wall emergence, and a Munch vs. Plumb 'bitch' debate where Crum's cousin admits stealing all Christmas presents. Trip Bradstein harvests chat-sourced street opinions including a snake activist and a 20% chicken man, before DJ Newsic closes with a Valentine's roof concert featuring a Trump trap rap about golden toilets and banned states, ending in a raid to Dank Sauce.
